decisions.reason: As a very recent machine launch that fits the firm's integrated precast line, it is still an option worth keeping while market acceptance remains uncertain, although hardware carrying costs and the firm's recent pruning of several 2023 robot launches raise the risk of withdrawal.

This newly launched production analysis software is strategically aligned with the firm's automation direction and likely has relatively low carrying cost, so under real options logic it is worth retaining while customer value continues to emerge.
